decision: The clean single-stage gain was5.6485percent and depended on a new generator plus controlled bank placement. Preserve the simpler fully qualified R14 implementation rather than reopening qualification.

forms.notation: p is a direct unsigned8 ID in the original AST; K is a compile-time integer literal0..255, not a runtime parameter.

qualified_domain: Only known flat global one-byte-element arrays already selected by the production small-array generator (totalbytes1..256).
Original subscript must be a direct BinaryOp addition with unsigned8 ID on the left and nonnegative integer literal0..255 on the right.
Existing original-index in-bounds assumption remains mandatory. With p0..255 and K0..255, valid p+K is at most255 and cannot overflow the cc65 16-bit promoted addition.

Preserve source casts, qualifiers and original AST. Decline local typedef cases and conflicting/shadowing declarations; pointer variables/array parameters/large arrays/signed or wider index IDs retain production emission.

The pointer-base form keeps element type and const/volatile qualification through ordinary array pointer arithmetic. Valid final index also implies the constant base displacement is within the same array.

case_kinds: all valid base indices for literals0,1,2,3,7,15,17,19,49,51,127,255
explicit author wrap casts, signed negative bases, u16wrap, pointer and array-parameter exclusions
global/local/parameter/type shadowing and local typedef exclusions
negative_controls: dropping the eligible constant displacement is detected
existing wrong element-scale and illegal257-byte-array-wrap controls are detected
semantic_evidence.claim_limit: Finite actual6502 cases plus bounded C-semantics reasoning; no new whole-game or arbitrary-program equivalence claim.

controlled_native_comparison.cycle_boundary_note: Candidate mapper-hook sum89341496 plus two pending X.tcount cycles equals native timestamp delta89341498. A repeat with X.tcount capture matched all original outputs and explained the boundary difference exactly.

earlier_trials.reason: All unprotected R13 timings are invalid for ranking because the confirmed non-atomic mapper bank-publication race could execute bytes from the wrong physical bank.

controlled_layout_failure.interpretation: CPU KIL/JAM caused by physical/software bank disagreement; not ordinary slow execution.

limits: The clean R14 comparison is one deterministic50-second-class dense-stage cohort, not an all-stage performance claim.
Observer neutrality covers actualPCM, complete serialized state, every watched RAM frame, finalSYSTEM/SAVE RAM, finalimage and CPU/stack/bank snapshots.
Bank consistency checked every banked-window ROM read in the observed interval; it is finite runtime evidence, not a proof for every interrupt interleaving.
All raw assets, states, traces, histograms, generated C, private generator and experimental binaries remain outside Git.
No production source, intended cartridge or installed package was changed for the experiment.
